title: The Informer's Offer
text: A man in a rival House's colours finds each House's camp alone in the night, slipping between the tents without a sound. To each he makes the same offer, in the same soft voice: tell him the others' weakness, and he will see you are paid for it.

options.label: Send him away into the dark, and trust the others to do the same.

outcomes.text: He shrugs and slips away. It seems every House sent him off, which leaves him looking tired and faintly disappointed.
He goes. By morning it is clear that someone told him exactly where your Scions are weakest.

options.label: Tell him what he wants to hear. Every House would do the same, given the chance.

outcomes.text: He pays in old silver, still warm from his hand. No one need ever know, unless he chooses to tell.
He pays you, then pays the others for the very same service. He leaves laughing into the night, carrying every House's secrets.
